title: UW Protocol Error
description: Structured error returned by any conforming implementation when an operation fails. Mirrors the ProtocolError interface in @uwmd/core/protocol.ts. See UW_PROTOCOL_v1.md §XI for the full error taxonomy and the per-category code prefixes.

category.description: Top-level error class. Drives which subsystem the implementer surfaces it to.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Conventional prefixes: PROTO-EDIT-*, CALC-*, MOD-*, AGENT-*, VAL-*, RENDER-*. New codes added by modules SHOULD prefix the module id (e.g. HOSP-LSTAR-001).

message.description: Human-readable description. Localized to en-US in v1.

pointer.description: Path into the file (e.g. 'frontmatter.quick_metrics.dscr', 'sections.noi_model.content.net_operating_income'). Helps editors highlight the offending location.

remediation.description: Suggested fix. SHOULD reuse the BUILTIN_REMEDIATIONS copy when the code matches a registered remediation.

cause.description: Underlying error message if this wraps a thrown exception.

examples.message: Cannot replace section 'risk_assessment' — source 'agent/L6-01' has supersede_on_edit:true. Use kind=section_supersede instead.
Division by zero in formula 'noi_model.net_operating_income / debt_structure.annual_debt_service'.

examples.remediation: Recompute DSCR = NOI / annual_debt_service and update both surfaces.
